Notes on local-first software

Local-first software keeps the primary copy of your data on your own device. The network is an optimisation, not a requirement.

That changes what an outage means. When the server is down, a local-first app keeps working, and it syncs when the connection comes back, which is the property people notice first.

It also changes who owns the data: a file on your disk outlives the company that wrote the app that made it.

The cloud is just someone else's computer.

Images like are left out of a clip, their words are kept.
